tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground: every page and every slide. The website is white with one colour block, the band; cards and lists stand on the ground without fills.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The band's ground, and the colour of the band's lines where they hang below it onto the page. Also the link underline, dotted at rest and solid on hover and keyboard focus (1.9:1 on surface; links are also set at 700). Dark value not decided.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: What is drawn on the band: the title, the lines, the plain nodes, the white discs. The title on sky is 1.9:1, accepted to match the designer; the drawing is decoration and hidden from assistive technology. White in both themes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The note's paper: from 1280px where the note lies on top of the band, and the Postit, the note off the front page. Nothing else uses it. Carries heading (13.6:1), blue (4.0:1) and coral (2.8:1, bold only). Dark value not decided.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: The one panel tint. If something needs to read as a panel, it is this. In the new look it is inline code only: the table of contents, the header's current link and the script selector's notice have no tint. No slide component uses it: a statement panel on a slide is white and framed by hairlines. Only code set by hand on a slide takes it.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: A step darker than surface-tint, for small fills that sit on a panel or need to be told apart from one. In the new look it is only the empty circle behind a portrait in the team list (PeopleGrid). No slide uses it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline (line-hairline thick): the rules between list rows, the footer's rules, table rules, hr. Decorative; nothing depends on seeing it (1.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Lines that carry meaning and must hold 3:1: chart axes, including the axis rule on a slide's bar chart. On the website: the marker beside a country in the usage figures and the underline of a link in InstitutionCard. 3.3:1 on surface, 3.1:1 on surface-tint (light); 4.1:1 and 3.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Ink: headings, card and list headings, row titles, the date numeral, the note's title and body. 14.4:1 on surface, 13.6:1 on paper, 7.7:1 on sky (light); 16:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and anything read in sentences: the cards' sentences, the line about the newsletter and the team, the lists' More. 11.2:1 on surface (light); 13.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: eyebrows on the cards, the month in a row's date, an event's place. 5.5:1 on surface (light); 7.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: nav-text
tokens.usage: The site's muted grey, #6a6a6a, as the site has always had it: the header's six links, its tagline and the active link's label, the footer's small labels and copyright line, and secondary lines on the content pages. A step lighter than text-muted. Links turn blue on hover and focus. 5.4:1 on surface (light); 7.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The site's base ink, #333333: the body and shell colour, and the header's name. Reading text inside a page uses text. 12.6:1 on surface (light); 13.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: A rule softer than border: the horizontal rule, table row lines and the skip link's frame on the content pages. Decorative.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand blue, the one working colour: the band's subtitle (2.3:1 on sky, accepted to match the designer), the band's lower edge and its step, the blue node on that edge, the arrow disc, the note's line and its link text. 4.3:1 on surface and 4.0:1 on paper, so as text it is for links and labels, never body copy.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Retired: the new look has no tinted panels. No slide or component uses it; only the Cover preview's drawing does. Kept until the site's Sass drops it.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand coral, only as small spots: the note's eyebrow, its corner node, the node in the band's step. 3.0:1 on surface and 2.8:1 on paper: text only bold (the note's eyebrow is 800). Text on a coral fill is heading.

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: Retired: the new look has no tinted panels. No slide or component uses it. Kept until the site's Sass drops it.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand yellow, only as small spots and never text: the node under the map pin on the band's edge. Text on a yellow fill is heading.

tokens.name: yellow-text
tokens.usage: Retired: yellow is a spot, never text, and no slide or component uses this token. Kept until the site's Sass drops it. 1.9:1 on surface; the dark value is the brand yellow, 11.9:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: yellow-tint
tokens.usage: Retired: the new look has no tinted panels, and the post-it note is `paper`. No slide or component uses it. Kept until the site's Sass drops it.

tokens.name: road
tokens.usage: Retired: a line with a node per step took the road's place on slides and on the website. No component uses it; only the Cover preview's drawing does. Kept until the site's Sass drops it. Never text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a blue fill, 4.3:1 on blue, so bold at 19px and up. No component fills blue behind text now, so no component uses it; the script selector's frame is on surface. On coral and yellow fills use heading instead.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a 2px solid outline at 2px offset. 4.3:1 on surface and 4.0:1 on surface-tint (light), 6.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (the Netherlands on the impact globe). Every mark keeps its value as text.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (Germany).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (United States), from _data/usage.yml. 2.1:1 on surface: every mark carries its value as text.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (United Kingdom), from _data/usage.yml. 2.6:1 on surface: every mark carries its value as text. Dark value is proposed.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (Austria): violet, 4.2:1 on surface.

groups.name: Web · Headings
groups.note: Libre Caslon Condensed at weight 420 and letter spacing 0, for large headings. Provisional: Laura was asked to choose among three earlier candidates and has not seen this one; another face is a change to the serif family and its two font files. The files cover weights 400 to 700. The display family is the same serif stack: website and slide headings both use it, so the components that read --font-display (website and slide parts alike) take the serif.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Open Infrastructure for Data Donation Research
styles.usage: The front page's title in the band, in on-sky, always two lines, from 1000px. A line runs through it at band-thread, between two nodes.

styles.name: title-md
styles.sample: Open Infrastructure for Data Donation Research
styles.usage: The title from 600 to 999px.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.sample: Open Infrastructure for Data Donation Research
styles.usage: The title below 600px.

styles.name: card-heading
styles.usage: The heading of each of the three cards under the band, in heading. It is a whole-line link: it keeps this weight and takes the link underline.

styles.name: list-heading
styles.usage: The heading of each list (Latest news, Upcoming events), in heading, with More and the arrow disc at the end of its line.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The day in a list row's date, in heading, under the month set as an eyebrow.

groups.name: Web · Text
groups.note: Nunito Sans for everything that is not a large heading. The rounded Nunito is retired from the website.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Digital Trace Data, donated to science by citizens.
styles.usage: The subtitle under the title in the band, in blue (2.3:1 on sky, accepted to match the designer), from 1000px.

styles.name: lead-md
styles.sample: Digital Trace Data, donated to science by citizens.
styles.usage: The band's subtitle below 1000px. It keeps the reference's exact size, as the band does.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You can also subscribe to our newsletter or reach out to one of our team members if you have any questions!
styles.usage: Everything read in sentences, in text: the line about the newsletter and the team, and the cards' sentences (at line height 1.55).

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: The title of a news or event row, in heading. It is a whole-line link: it keeps this weight and takes the link underline, offset line-underline-offset-title.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A service provided by ODISSEI and supported by Eyra
styles.usage: The lists' base size and the footer, in text or heading.

styles.name: note-text
styles.sample: The European Omnibus Act poses a direct risk to fundamental human rights and to data donation as a research method.
styles.usage: The note's body sentence, in heading: on the paper from 1280px, in the niche from 1000 to 1279px, left out below.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small secondary lines: an event's place in a list row (set at 700, in text-muted), and the footer's copyright line (in nav-text).

groups.name: Web · Labels and links
groups.note: Nunito Sans at 700 and up for anything clicked or scanned rather than read. Uppercase only for eyebrows.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: One to three words above a card heading, and the month in a list row's date, in text-muted. Always uppercase (text-transform: uppercase), always with this tracking.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Short labels you click or scan: More at the end of each list's heading line (in text), and the footer's lines and labels (in heading).

styles.name: note-label
styles.usage: The note's eyebrow (in coral), its title (in heading) and its link text on the tab (in blue, line height 30px).

styles.name: link
styles.usage: A link in running text: the text in its own colour at 700, with a dotted underline in sky (line-underline thick, line-underline-offset below the text) that turns solid on hover and on keyboard focus. It takes the size of the text around it; the size here is body's. A title that is a whole-line link keeps its own weight and takes the same underline.

groups.name: Web · Code
groups.note: The system mono stack on surface-tint. On slides use 'Courier New', monospace, since this stack is not a web font.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and pre blocks on surface-tint; inside text it is 0.875em of its surroundings.

groups.name: Slides · 1920 × 1080
groups.note: Titles, the part number and stat numerals are the provisional serif (the display family) at weight 420 and no tracking, as on the website. Text is Nunito Sans, the footer row included. Seven sizes: 24, 28, 36, 48, 64, 96, 200px. Nothing on a slide is under 24px. Eyebrows and titles carry data-fit="none" so the Slides canvas never shrinks them.

styles.name: slide-numeral
styles.usage: The part number on a section opener, in the serif in blue. Nothing else is this big.

styles.name: slide-display
styles.sample: Data donation as a data collection method
styles.usage: The title of the network cover, in heading, at most two lines. The band-title cover sets its title at the front page band's size, enlarged by 4/3.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.sample: Each export covers at most six months of viewing
styles.usage: Every content slide's heading, in heading, at the top margin, one line (two at most), in the serif. It states a finding or names a topic.

styles.name: slide-stat
styles.usage: Numbers in stat columns, in the serif in blue. The numbers under a plan's nodes use the serif at 48px, in blue.

styles.name: slide-heading
styles.usage: A one-sentence claim: the section opener's sentence, a finding set as a statement, the plan's part numbers, in heading.

styles.name: slide-subheading
styles.usage: Titles of cards in a row and the part headers under the plan's line, in heading.

styles.name: slide-lead
styles.sample: Collecting digital trace data through participants' right of access
styles.usage: The one-line lead under the cover title, in text-muted.

styles.name: slide-item
styles.usage: Bold lines inside a slide: row titles in a build, list-item titles, the title bar of a drawn window, the byline, in heading.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: What was liked, from whom, and when.
styles.usage: Body text on slides: one line in a card, a statement in a panel, in text.

styles.name: slide-small
styles.sample: Illustration drawn from a test export, not a screenshot.
styles.usage: Second lines under an item, cells in a dense table, list items in a panel, captions and source lines, in text or text-muted. Nothing on a slide is smaller.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: The footer (site name and slide number, in text-muted), stop labels, axis labels, bar values (at 800), pills and tabs.

styles.name: slide-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase words above a slide title, in text-muted; blue on the cover. Nunito Sans, tracked 3px.

spacing.note: One 4px-based scale for both media. Pages mostly use 8 to 64; slides use 24 to 128. The front page's own gutter, gaps and section spaces are in layout.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: a title to its meta line, a label to its value.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title, chip gaps, paragraph padding (0.5em at body size).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Small inner gaps: blockquote and pill padding, rows of chips, items in a sidebar list.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The base unit: the gap between a list row's date and its title, callout and table-of-contents padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps; on slides the gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Figure margins, the content grid gap; on slides card padding and the gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Between page sections and above the footer; on slides between columns and between a title block and the body.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Between journey steps, above the contact block, the main column's bottom padding; on slides the footer row's distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Large page breaks: between hub steps on wide screens, the hero's bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: The slide margin on all four sides (136px at the bottom where a footer row sits).

radius.note: If something is curved, it is a line or a node; everything else has square corners. The radius tokens are kept, at 0, so that anything that reads them takes the square corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 0: square. Inline code, the script selector's frame. The system's corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: 0: square. The skip link. The system's corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: 0: square. Embedded frames, the journey hub's hero image, the table of contents, InstitutionCard. The system's corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: 0: square. No component uses it. The system's corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: 0: square. No component uses it. The system's corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Nodes, discs and portraits: with lines, the only round things. Also portraits, route stops and bullets.

shadow.note: The new look has one shadow, under the note's paper (the front page's note and the Postit). The three soft steps are no longer used by any component or slide; they stay until the site's Sass drops them.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: No component uses it any more. Barely there; kept until the site's Sass drops it.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: No component uses it any more; kept until the site's Sass drops it.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: No component uses it any more (the post-it takes `shadow-note`); kept until the site's Sass drops it.

tokens.name: shadow-note
tokens.usage: The note's paper (the front page's note from 1280px, and the Postit), as a filter so it follows the tab's shape: filter: drop-shadow(var(--shadow-note)). The only shadow in the new look.

layout.note: Widths for pages and the slide canvas, and the front page's gutter, gaps and section spaces.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The page gutter at every width: the least space between content and the window's edge.

tokens.name: site-width
tokens.usage: The column (1152px at the default text size): the header, the cards, the lists and the footer sit inside it, centred.

tokens.name: page-edge
tokens.usage: The left and right padding that puts content in the column: the gutter in narrow windows, the column's margin plus the gutter in wide ones. The header, the cards, the lists, the footer and the note in the niche start here.

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Between the three cards, from 1000px.

tokens.name: card-gap-md
tokens.usage: Between the cards below 1000px: two columns (the third card spans both), one below 600px.

tokens.name: list-gap
tokens.usage: Between the two lists side by side.

tokens.name: list-gap-stacked
tokens.usage: Between the two lists once they stack, below 900px.

tokens.name: cards-top
tokens.usage: From the band's lower edge to the cards.

tokens.name: outro-top
tokens.usage: From the cards to the line about the newsletter and the team.

tokens.name: section-space
tokens.usage: The white space between that line and the two lists: the front page's one large break.

tokens.name: lists-bottom
tokens.usage: Below the lists, above the footer's rule.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: The reading column: prose, figures, lists, routes, cards.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The longest a lead or a slide's body line runs.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The section sidebar beside the reading column, from the 900px breakpoint.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: The slide canvas width.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: The slide canvas height.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: The slide's inner margin on every side (136px at the bottom above a footer row). Headings sit at the top margin on every slide.

line.note: Line weights and dot spacings. Every piece sits on a line; every line starts and ends at a node or leaves the page. Level changes take the designer's shape: a rounded corner, a straight diagonal, a rounded corner. Dotted lines are a round cap on a near-zero dash.

tokens.name: line-band
tokens.usage: Solid lines on the band, in on-sky: the story's lines, the research side's lines, the line through the title.

tokens.name: line-page
tokens.usage: Solid lines on the page: the band's lower edge and its step (blue), the story where it hangs below the band (sky), the note's run along its tab (blue).

tokens.name: line-dot-band
tokens.usage: The dot of a dotted line on the band (stroke width).

tokens.name: line-dot-page
tokens.usage: The dot of a dotted line below the band (sky), and of the dots before each list's More.

tokens.name: line-dash
tokens.usage: The dash pattern of every dotted line in the band's drawing, on the band and below it (stroke-dasharray, with stroke-linecap: round): dots 6.6px apart.

tokens.name: line-dot-note
tokens.usage: The dot of the note's dotted line along its tab (blue), from 1280px.

tokens.name: line-dash-note
tokens.usage: Its dash pattern: dots 4.7px apart.

tokens.name: line-dot-spacing
tokens.usage: Dotted lines drawn in HTML as a repeating 2px dot (radial-gradient, line-dot-page high): one dot every 5px. The dots before each list's More, in sky.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairlines in border: between list rows and in the footer.

tokens.name: line-underline
tokens.usage: The link underline's thickness (text-decoration-thickness), dotted in sky at rest, solid on hover and keyboard focus.

tokens.name: line-underline-offset
tokens.usage: How far the link underline sits below the text in running text (text-underline-offset).

tokens.name: line-underline-offset-title
tokens.usage: The same for a title that is a whole-line link: card headings and row titles.

node.note: Node and disc sizes. Large discs are meaningful nodes with an icon; small white dots are plain nodes. Sizes are diameters.

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: A plain node: a white dot on a line in the band, and the two nodes either side of the title, 6px outside its column. The note's coral corner node is the same size.

tokens.name: node-edge
tokens.usage: A node on the band's lower edge: the coral node in the step, the blue node on the deep side.

tokens.name: node-ring
tokens.usage: The ring node where the note's dotted line ends on the tab: white, with a 1.4px blue ring.

tokens.name: node-scale
tokens.usage: The display scale of the designer's pieces: a size in the hero file times this is its size on the page.

tokens.name: disc
tokens.usage: A meaningful node: an icon in a disc (globe, music note, chart, funnel, the two portraits). The designer's 66-unit disc at node-scale.

tokens.name: disc-sm
tokens.usage: A small disc: the tick on the funnel's dotted circle. The designer's 43-unit disc at node-scale.

tokens.name: disc-arrow
tokens.usage: The arrow disc, a blue disc with a white arrow: on the note's corner from 1280px, after the note's title in the niche below. The chart on the anchor is drawn at this size, so the note's disc covers it.

tokens.name: disc-arrow-sm
tokens.usage: The arrow disc after More at the end of each list's heading line.

band.note: The band at the top of the front page, and the note that lies on it. Unsuffixed values hold from the widest window; -lg applies from 1000 to 1279px, -md from 600 to 999px, -sm below 600px (see breakpoint). The drawing's own positions stay in docs/front-page-reference/source/build.py.

tokens.name: band-depth
tokens.usage: The band's depth on its shallow (left) side, from 1280px.

tokens.name: band-depth-lg
tokens.usage: The shallow depth from 1000 to 1279px.

tokens.name: band-depth-md
tokens.usage: The shallow depth from 600 to 999px.

tokens.name: band-depth-sm
tokens.usage: The shallow depth below 600px.

tokens.name: band-drop
tokens.usage: How much deeper the band is right of the step in its lower edge, from 1280px. The deep side is band-depth plus band-drop.

tokens.name: band-drop-lg
tokens.usage: The drop from 1000 to 1279px: the niche under the shallow side holds the note.

tokens.name: band-drop-md
tokens.usage: The drop below 1000px, phones included.

tokens.name: band-step-width
tokens.usage: The width of the step in the band's lower edge, the designer's S-curve, with the coral node at its middle. From 1280px it is centred on the page; below, it sits band-niche-gap right of the niche.

tokens.name: band-step-width-sm
tokens.usage: The step's width below 600px.

tokens.name: band-niche-lg
tokens.usage: The niche's width from 1000 to 1279px, as a share of the band's width: the note lies in it, under the shallow side, from page-edge.

tokens.name: band-niche-md
tokens.usage: The niche's width from 600 to 999px.

tokens.name: band-niche-sm
tokens.usage: The niche's width below 600px.

tokens.name: band-niche-gap
tokens.usage: Below 1280px, the space between the niche and the step.

tokens.name: band-half
tokens.usage: Half the width of the title's column, from 1000px. The title block is twice this plus 40px wide, centred.

tokens.name: band-half-md
tokens.usage: Half the title's column from 600 to 999px.

tokens.name: band-half-sm
tokens.usage: Half the title's column below 600px.

tokens.name: band-pad
tokens.usage: From the band's top to the title, from 1000px.

tokens.name: band-pad-md
tokens.usage: From the band's top to the title, from 600 to 999px.

tokens.name: band-pad-sm
tokens.usage: From the band's top to the title, below 600px.

tokens.name: band-gap
tokens.usage: Between the title's column and the drawing on either side, from 1000px.

tokens.name: band-gap-md
tokens.usage: The same, below 1000px.

tokens.name: band-thread
tokens.usage: The thread: the line through the title, down from the band's top. It is band-pad + 2.06 × the title's size + 9px. The band's drawings are made with it at 146px and moved with it.

tokens.name: band-thread-md
tokens.usage: The thread from 600 to 999px (title-md).

tokens.name: band-thread-sm
tokens.usage: The thread below 600px (title-sm).

tokens.name: band-story-width
tokens.usage: The participant's story, left of the title, stretches with the space up to this width, the designer's own.

tokens.name: band-story-depth
tokens.usage: The story's depth: deeper than the band, so its lower part hangs below the band's edge, where its lines turn sky.

tokens.name: band-anchor-x
tokens.usage: The anchor across, from 1280px: this far into the space right of the title (which starts band-gap right of the title's column). The anchor is the one point the band and the note share: the centre of the note's arrow disc. The band keeps the chart there, at disc-arrow.

tokens.name: band-anchor-y
tokens.usage: The anchor down, from the band's top.

tokens.name: band-corner-x
tokens.usage: The note's coral corner node lies this far left of the anchor. It is also the note's width from 1280px.

tokens.name: band-corner-y
tokens.usage: The coral corner node lies this far below the anchor. It is also the height of the note's tab. The band brings its line to this height.

tokens.name: note-padding
tokens.usage: The note's paper padding, from 1280px. The note hangs from the anchor and grows upwards with its text.

tokens.name: note-tab-width
tokens.usage: The tab at the paper's lower left that holds the link, band-corner-y high; its right end is the designer's S-curve.

tokens.name: note-gap
tokens.usage: Below 1280px, in the niche: between the note's eyebrow and title, its body, and its arrow disc.

tokens.name: note-gap-sm
tokens.usage: The same, below 600px.

breakpoint.note: Desktop-first, as the reference writes them: a tier's -lg, -md or -sm tokens apply below its breakpoint, as a max-width query one pixel less (below 1000px is (max-width: 999px)), down to the next breakpoint. The lists have their own.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: From 1280px: the full story and research side, with the note on its paper, hung from the anchor. Below: the first compression (-lg tokens), and the note in the niche.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Below 1000px: the tablet tier (-md tokens): fewer pieces in the band, title-md and lead-md, the note without its body, the cards in two columns.

tokens.name: bp-lists
tokens.usage: Below 900px the two lists stack into one column.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Below 600px: the phone tier (-sm tokens): only the globe, on the band's edge; title-sm; the cards in one column.
